title: Сохранить fresh scope и недренированный interval в backlog/delta recovery
summary: Исправить A2: recovery использует subject scope исходного fresh profile и сохраняет каждый dense/capped interval до доказанного `Drained`. RAG:— (repo-grounded: `@plan/knowledge/artifacts-PARSING_PRODUCTION_ACCEPTANCE.json:77-108`).
why: Выбор первого archive profile меняет stages/OKPD/price scope, а `array_pop` на cap/min interval удаляет невыполненное обязательство и позволяет отметить backlog rescanned. RAG:— (repo-grounded: `@plan/knowledge/artifacts-PARSING_PRODUCTION_AUDIT.json`, A2).

include: exact recovery-scope carrier derived from fresh profile; compatibility validation if a separate crawler is execution carrier; durable dense-window stack/checkpoint; explicit non-drained/operator-debt result at unsplittable cap; backlog/delta only mark completion after every branch drained; tests for mismatched stages/OKPD/price and repeated resume.
exclude: execution lease (P1.4); widening profile scope; dropping max-block protection; live traffic.

rules: Recovery subject is the source fresh scope plus update window; an archive crawler may provide runtime settings but must not replace the subject filter. `array_pop` is legal only after a branch is proven drained or its replacement children are durably stored. Unsplittable cap is visible nonterminal/operator debt, never `Drained`. Unknown filter mapping fails closed through existing registry. RAG:— (repo-grounded: `@plan/knowledge/research-01-remediation-architecture.json`).
guidance: Add rollback regressions where archive has `stageCompleted=true` and fresh does not, and where OKPD/price differ; assert generated request keeps fresh subject fields. Dense min interval/max-block test must resume from durable stack and eventually consume an injected later row. Do not hardcode fz44 filter arrays outside the typed DTO/registry. If `RecoveryScope` cannot be serialized in cursor without breaking compatibility, add a new D# before changing schema.

Closure: requests preserve fresh subject, every popped interval is proven drained or replaced durably, fresh `backlog_rescanned_at` remains null on incomplete debt, later resume consumes the remainder, commands green.
